mods.blocked: The game’s mods folder has files this setup did not add, or files changed outside Portcove. Portcove does not change mods until they are moved or restored, so they are never overwritten.

browse.conflictsHeading: Changes the same files as your other mods
browse.fileArchived: <file /> ({{size}}); archived, so it can’t be installed
browse.heading: Mods on GameBanana for <name />
browse.ignored_one: {{count}} other entry in the download isn’t a mod package and isn’t installed.
browse.ignored_other: {{count}} other entries in the download aren’t mod packages and aren’t installed.
browse.intro: Names, popularity and version labels come from GameBanana and don’t show that a mod works with this game. Portcove downloads a file privately and checks it before you decide to install it.
browse.inUse: This setup is in use, so the game’s mods folder changes as soon as you install.
browse.lockNote: Finish or cancel the GameBanana review to change other mods or setups.
browse.noFiles: This mod has no files Portcove can list.
browse.notInUse: This setup isn’t in use; its mods change the next time you use it.
browse.obsolete: Its author marked it obsolete, so Portcove won’t install it.
browse.stale: GameBanana couldn’t be reached, so this is earlier data from {{time}}. Check again before installing anything.
browse.truncated: More shared files exist than are listed here.
browse.unreadable_one: {{count}} more file on GameBanana couldn’t be read safely and isn’t listed.
browse.unreadable_other: {{count}} more files on GameBanana couldn’t be read safely and aren’t listed.

mods.busy: Finish the current operation before changing mods.

code.digest: Your permission covers only this exact file: <digest />. Portcove asks again for a different file, including a later version.
code.intro: <name /> (<id />) runs its own code inside the game. Portcove can’t tell whether that code is safe, who wrote it or whether it works with this version of the game. Add it only if you trust where it came from.
code.runs: The game’s mod runtime turns the mod’s code into game code and runs it while you play.

mods.copyIntro: A copy has the same mods but starts with no saves and the game’s default settings. Your current setup keeps its own.
mods.empty: No mods. The game plays without changes in this setup.
mods.gameChanged: This game changed. Refresh its details before changing mods.
mods.heading: Setups and mods

held.intro_one: Portcove kept the current version of a mod because its update needs your review:
held.intro_other: Portcove kept the current versions of some mods because their updates need your review:
held.next_one: To install it anyway, find the mod with Find mods on GameBanana below and review the newer file. Or leave it: Portcove checks again when this setup changes or the mod offers another file.
held.next_other: To install them anyway, find each mod with Find mods on GameBanana below and review its newer file. Or leave them: Portcove checks again when this setup changes or a mod offers another file.

mods.intro: A setup is a set of mods with its own saves and settings. Switching setups puts away the current setup’s saves and settings and brings back the other setup’s. Turning a mod off removes it from the game’s mods folder; its file stays in Portcove so you can turn it on again.
mods.laterPriority: Later mods in this list take priority when two mods change the same thing.
mods.loadOrder: The game loads mods in this order.

native.differs: The game's mod list does not match this setup. Portcove restores this setup's mods and order before the next launch.
native.notWritten: Portcove writes this setup's mod order into the game before the next launch.
native.reordered: You reordered mods in the game (<order />). Portcove keeps that order for this setup.
native.unreadable: Portcove could not read the game's settings file, so it leaves it unchanged. The game may load mods in its own order.

mods.none: This game has no setup yet. Your current saves and settings become its first setup.
mods.otherBuild: This setup stays on the game version it was made with, so game updates don’t change it. To try these mods with the game’s current version, copy the setup onto it. This setup and its saves stay as they are.

outcome.copied: Created {{name}} with the same mods, no saves and default settings.
outcome.copiedCurrent: Created {{name}} on the game’s current version with the same mods, no saves and default settings.
outcome.createdFirst: Created the first setup from your current saves and settings.
